cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Review the key vocabulary for this session below:

cosy-blockquote.p: Bee – a small yellow and black insect that makes honey.

p.em: Example: I see a small bee on a flower.

cosy-blockquote.p: Honey – a very sweet yellow food made by bees.

p.em: Example: I eat honey with my bread.

cosy-blockquote.p: Garden – a green place next to a house with plants and flowers.

p.em: Example: My house has a small garden with green grass.

cosy-blockquote.p: Flower – the beautiful and colored part of a plant.

p.em: Example: This red flower smells very nice.

cosy-blockquote.p: Tree – a very tall green plant in nature.

p.em: Example: There is a big green tree in front of my window.

cosy-blockquote.p: Help – to make something easy or good for someone.

p.em: Example: Please help me plant these flowers.

cosy-blockquote.p: Sweet – having a pleasant taste of sugar.

p.em: Example: This hot tea is very sweet because it has sugar.

cosy-blockquote.p: City – a very big town with many houses and streets.

p.em: Example: I live in a big and noisy city.

cosy-blockquote.p: House – a building where people live.

p.em: Example: My parents live in a small white house.

cosy-blockquote.p: Insect – a very small animal with six legs.

p.em: Example: A bee is a useful insect.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: pair/group discussion on core session themes.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs or small breakout groups, discuss the following questions:

ol.li:
How does a little yellow bee find sweet flowers in a big city?
★ Do you see busy bees flying near your house?

Why do bees make honey, and how does it taste?
★ Do you like to eat sweet honey on your bread?

Does an urban garden have many plants, and who helps water them?
★ Is there a beautiful park or garden near your home?

Why does a colorful flower grow best when it has water and sunlight?
★ Do you have a favorite flower?

How does a big green tree help clean the air in our crowded streets?
★ Are there many tall trees in your neighborhood?

Do you want to help local beekeepers protect wild hives?
★ Do you help your friends keep their balconies clean?

What makes fresh, natural honey so incredibly sweet?
★ Do you prefer sweet fruit or sugary candies?

How does a modern city change when citizens grow plants on every balcony?
★ Do you live in a big city or a small village?

Does a quiet green house feel more relaxed than a noisy city apartment?
★ Do you live in a multi-story house or a single-floor flat?

Why do some people feel afraid when a small insect flies near their face?
★ What is your favorite small insect in nature?

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: deeper debate and statement evaluation in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, debate and state whether you agree or disagree with these statements:

ol.li:
In the future, every house in the city has a small green roof with flowers to attract bees.
★ Do you want to have a colorful flower garden on the roof of your house?

People do not buy sugar, they only use sweet honey as a healthy alternative.
★ Do you prefer to use sweet honey or white sugar in your warm tea?

Every school has a beautiful garden with fruit trees to teach kids about pollination.
★ Do you want to help water plants in a school garden?

Robots protect every green tree in the urban forest from destruction.
★ Do you like to sit under a big green tree to read a book?

Children learn about every insect from real observation, not from computer screens.
★ Do you prefer to look at a small insect in nature or in a video game?

Cars do not enter the city center, making the streets safe for local bee colonies.
★ Do you like to ride an electric bike or walk in your city?

All citizens learn how to help keep local parks clean and green.
★ Do you like to help street animals in your area?

Every urban balcony has a red flower to create a massive corridor for bees.
★ Do you have a colorful flower at home?

Beekeepers build warm wooden hotels for every little bee to survive the winter.
★ Do you want to help build a small house for a bee?

People live in harmony with nature and make delicious, organic honey in their backyards.
★ Would you like to collect fresh honey with a beekeeper?

ul.li: Incorrect: The bee have beautiful wings. → Correct: The bee has beautiful wings. ((Subject-verb agreement: 'The bee' is singular, use 'has'.))
Incorrect: I saw a bee on yesterday. → Correct: I saw a bee yesterday. ((Time adverb: do not use the preposition 'on' before 'yesterday'.))
Incorrect: He is afraid to bees. → Correct: He is afraid of bees. ((Preposition check: the adjective 'afraid' is followed by the preposition 'of'.))
